stage.title: Implement barrier compiler and queue synchronization plan

goal: Move complex transition planning and cross-queue synchronization out of RHI preprocessing and into a deterministic RenderGraph compiler that emits batched barriers, reordered barriers, and an RHIExecutor submit dependency plan.
entry_gate: M1 resource declaration model is frozen.
Pass queue intent is known before compile.
Imported resources have known initial state and exported resources declare final state.

hard_rules.rule: Do not infer RenderGraph dependencies by scanning recorded RHICommandList contents. Compile from pass declarations.
Do not emit per-resource barriers immediately when they can be batched at pass or queue boundaries.
Do not let one compiled queue segment import from multiple source queues. Split the segment instead.
Do not keep a parallel RenderGraph submit path beside RHIExecutor.

checkpoints.title: Build canonical resource interval keys
checkpoints.problem: Barrier compilation needs a canonical key space for whole resources, texture subresources, and buffer ranges before hazards can be analyzed deterministically.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Texture interval keys normalize aspect, mip range, and array range.
Buffer interval keys normalize byte ranges and whole-buffer access.
Whole-resource access and partial-range access have explicit conflict rules.
Alias-capable transient resources are represented separately from imported persistent resources.

checkpoints.title: Compile pass hazards from declared accesses
checkpoints.problem: The graph must derive read-after-write, write-after-read, write-after-write, queue ownership, and aliasing hazards without backend command scanning.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Each pass records incoming and outgoing resource state requirements from declarations.
Hazard edges are generated between conflicting intervals only.
Read-read edges are not generated unless queue ownership or aliasing requires them.
Bindless resources contribute edges only through explicitly declared underlying resources.

checkpoints.title: Implement barrier batching and reorder
checkpoints.problem: Naive per-edge barriers recreate backend tracker noise and increase command stream cost. The compiler must batch and reorder barriers without crossing semantic boundaries.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Barriers are grouped by queue, pass boundary, resource type, and compatible source/destination states.
Redundant read-read and same-state transitions are removed.
Barrier reorder is deterministic and never moves a barrier across a conflicting resource access or queue handoff.
Compiled barriers are emitted as queue-local RHI Barriers or CopyScope boundary work, not as user-authored QueueTransfer commands.

checkpoints.title: Compile cross-queue synchronization
checkpoints.problem: Cross-queue ownership and GPU ordering currently require Vulkan preprocess inference. RenderGraph should emit explicit queue-stage handoff and submit dependencies before RHI translation starts.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Queue segments are split so each import has one source queue and each export has one destination queue.
Compiled queue handoffs include release/acquire state, source queue, destination queue, and dependent submit ordering.
RHIExecutor receives an ordered submit plan that can translate in parallel and submit with resolved GPU waits.
Present source resources are exported to the required Graphics/TRANSFER final state before present.

checkpoints.title: Add focused barrier and queue validation cases
checkpoints.problem: Barrier compilers fail silently without coverage for overlap, queue transfer, bindless explicit access, and present handoff cases.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Focused tests cover texture subresource hazards, buffer range hazards, barrier batching, queue split, and present handoff.
Focused tests cover bindless explicit resource access and reject hidden dependency assumptions.

stage_exit_gate: RenderGraph emits deterministic queue-local barriers and cross-queue handoffs from declarations.
Vulkan preprocess no longer needs to own RenderGraph-level subresource, buffer-range, or bindless resource inference for RDG-generated work.
Focused RHI/RDG tests cover the compiled barrier plan.
validation: Run testscripts/windows/test_rhi_translate.ps1 after implementation changes in this stage.
Run testscripts/windows/test_all.ps1 after the stage-sized landing.
